original.title: Warm Chickpea and Spinach Salad
original.description: A quick and warm vegetarian skillet dish featuring soft chickpeas, wilted spinach, and sweet cherry tomatoes with a splash of fresh lemon juice.
steps: Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add the rinsed canned chickpeas and cherry tomatoes.
Sauté for 4 to 5 minutes until the tomatoes begin to soften and burst slightly.
Add the fresh spinach and 1 tablespoon of water to the skillet, stirring gently until the spinach wilts, about 2 minutes.
Remove from heat, squeeze the fresh lemon juice over the top, stir to combine, and serve warm.
original.why: This recipe makes great use of your spinach and cherry tomatoes, which were marked to use soon, combining them into a simple, warm 10-minute meal.

request.adjustment: I only have a microwave and I am out of lemon. Adapt this recipe without lemon, using microwave-safe equipment.

recipe.title: Microwave Warm Chickpea, Spinach, and Tomato Salad
recipe.description: A fast and warm microwave dish featuring soft chickpeas, wilted spinach, and tender cherry tomatoes gently warmed with olive oil.
steps: Drain and rinse the canned chickpeas.
In a large microwave-safe bowl, combine the drained chickpeas, cherry tomatoes, and olive oil.
Cover the bowl loosely with a microwave-safe lid or plate and microwave on HIGH for 2 minutes, until the tomatoes begin to soften.
Carefully add the fresh spinach and 1 tablespoon of water to the bowl, tossing gently with the warm chickpea mixture.
Cover loosely again and microwave on HIGH for an additional 1 to 2 minutes until the spinach is wilted and the dish is warm throughout.
Stir well to combine the warm vegetables and olive oil, then serve immediately.
recipe.why: This microwave adaptation efficiently uses your spinach and cherry tomatoes, which are marked to use soon, while omitting the lemon per your request.
recipe.adjustmentSummary: Adapted the recipe for microwave cooking using a microwave-safe bowl instead of a stovetop skillet, and omitted the lemon juice completely.
